prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: square construction material reference image for an illustrative commercial interior estimate
Primary request: Architectural PVC fluted wall panels, clearly a manufactured PVC panel system rather than solid wood. Close-to-mid view of completed vertical tongue-and-groove panels in a quiet neutral commercial interior. Show a clean finished external corner with matching corner trim. At one small unfinished edge, reveal a modest installation detail with adhesive and concealed clips behind a panel.
Style/medium: natural editorial architectural product photograph, realistic material texture and soft daylight, no people.
Composition/framing: square composition, wall panels fill most of frame, sufficient context to understand the corner and small exposed edge, no collage, no exploded diagram.
Constraints: illustrative sample interior only, not any actual studio or job site. No text, numbers, labels, measurements, costs, logos, watermark, people, or certification marks.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: square construction work reference photograph for an illustrative commercial interior estimate
Primary request: A floor-to-ceiling built-in commercial plywood wardrobe with clean Formica laminate exterior and visible PVC edge banding. Show a pair of simple neutral laminated doors, one partly open so interior plywood shelves, a hanging rail, and realistic soft-close concealed hinges are clearly visible. The material should read as laminated plywood cabinetry, not solid timber.
Scene/backdrop: calm generic commercial changing or storage room, simple uncluttered interior.
Style/medium: realistic natural architectural product photography with soft daylight and believable joinery.
Composition/framing: square image, three-quarter view, wardrobe fills most of frame with floor and ceiling context, partly open door reveals hardware.
Constraints: illustrative sample only, no claim to depict an actual studio. No text, numbers, dimensions, costs, logos, watermarks, people, collage, or labels.
